title: Loeb Equivalence for General Internal Probability Spaces
summary: Loeb measure theory stands as one of the most influential concepts in nonstandard analysis, underpinning nearly all applications in probability, stochastic processes, and mathematical economics. The paper resolves a fundamental open problem in Loeb measure theory originally posed by Keisler and Sun: let $(Ω,\mathcal{F},μ)$ and $(Ω,\mathcal{G},ν)$ be two Loeb equivalent internal probability spaces, and $\mathcal H$ be the internal algebra generated from $\mathcal{F}\cup\mathcal{G}$.
